title: Traveler Name on Crestline Flight Credits and Travel Vouchers
content:
**Term 1.** The traveler name on a Crestline Flight Credits and Travel Vouchers credit may be corrected by at most the instrument's number of characters to match the government ID. That number is 3 characters on every instrument. The name may also be updated to a legal name change already shown on the customer profile.

**Term 2.** A name correction is made only while the credit is issued or active, as the system records the credit's status.

**Term 3.** A named-traveler-only credit is never re-issued to a different person. For the other instruments the traveler scope already governs who may travel, so the name is not changed to add a traveler.

## Application of the terms

| Request on a credit | Credit status | Outcome |
|---|---|---|
| Correct two letters of the surname to match the government ID | active | Within 3 characters; may be corrected |
| Correct four characters of the name to match the government ID | active | Beyond 3 characters; not a correction under term 1 |
| Update the name to a legal name change already on the customer profile | issued | May be updated |
| Any correction | expired, depleted, refunded or voided | Not made; corrections are made only while issued or active |
| Put a different person's name on a named-traveler-only credit | active | Never re-issued to a different person |
| Change the name on a credit with a wider traveler scope so that another person can travel | active | Not changed; the traveler scope governs who may travel |

The names and letter counts in the table are hypothetical.
